title: Does a preregistered, budgeted, SYMMETRIC recipe search clear the 0.05 margin bar at a 2048-byte carve, at the 500000-row rung, on 0011's sealed evaluation set? Four searched heads (the HGB model, logistic, depth-3 tree, deep tree) with eight enumerated recipes each and the 0011 recipe first in every list; one selection rule on one chunk-rule holdout; one confirmatory fit per head on 0011's pool, one scoring per role on 0011's evaluation set, the model last; every baseline head floored at its 0011 value.

scope.one_line: One corpus (0011's 2048-byte corpus C from its cache, not rebuilt), one seed (20260825), one rung (500000), 0011's sealed evaluation set scored once per role. It answers whether the incumbent's 0.0025 shortfall on the frozen reading (0.1741 against logistic 0.1266 + 0.05) and its +0.0294 expanded margin (against the depth-16 tree 0.1447) are artefacts of a recipe fixed on 4096-byte pilot data and never revisited, under a search that gives the baselines the same treatment, and nothing else.
scope.question_named_by_the_record: VERDICT.md, 0011 section, 'What it does not establish': 'a frozen-set margin 0.0025 short of the bar is exactly the gap a per-head recipe search might close, and that is a new preregistration (M1's question at a second size)'. And, from the 0010 section: 'a training recipe tuned under one architecture is not architecture-neutral, and freezing it privileges the incumbent. A fair 0011 would have to preregister a recipe search per head, not a shared recipe; that is recorded here as the open question.' This preregistration is that search.
scope.corpus: data/pivot/carve_c2048.npz exactly as 0011 left it: carve 2048, chunk offset 75000, chunk size 32768 from the cache's own build metadata (the script refuses any other cache), 650000 rows from 25000 source chunks 75000..99999 measured from the g array, 1108 features (tools/pivot/features.py, unchanged). The cache's y (int16) and g (int32) arrays hash to the values banked in artifacts/pivot/corpus_manifest.json for this file (7f008413fd5bff9a308ade8fa5769533c5ac557f66ce0f5789a664ac88316c73 and 070a4b086f8f7bb84d8c730bb7963525a3fa8ddb4c862dba209a765e8c406c0c); the script hashes the arrays it loaded and the reader requires equality. No corpus is built.
scope.seed: 20260825 throughout, as in 0003, 0006, 0007 and 0011. The only other seed is 20260826 (seed + 1), used solely to draw M8's chunk-grouped validation split, so that draw is visibly independent of every other draw in the run.
scope.rungs: One: 500000 rows, 0011's top rung, the same rows in the same order (grouped_split's return at cap 500000). No ladder and no slope: 0011's slope and its cluster interval stand.

scope.model_and_features: Features fixed: the 1108 columns of tools/pivot/features.py as stored in the cache. Only the fitting recipe on top of them is searched. Every searched head is an enumerated roster of exactly eight recipes, listed in scope.roster.heads with the 0011 recipe FIRST in each list; three knob-free heads (majority, stratified, best_single_feat) have one recipe each and are fitted only at the confirmatory stage. The rosters are not repeated here in prose: scope.roster is the sealed table, and its canonical-JSON sha256 is a literal in the frozen reader (ROSTER_SHA256), so nothing can be added, removed or re-parameterised after freezing without the reader saying VOID.
scope.why_the_search_is_symmetric: The model head and every baseline head with a hyperparameter get the same roster size (8), the same two stages on the same rows, the same holdout, the same metric (all-rows top-1 on the holdout, rounded to 4 decimals), the same tie rule (ties to the LOWER roster index, so a tie can only favour the 0011 recipe), one confirmatory fit on the same 500000 rows, and one scoring on the same evaluation set. What is NOT symmetric, and accepted: compute (an HGB fit costs several times a tree fit at the same rows, which favours the model); the evaluation-set maximum is over four (frozen) or six (expanded) baseline heads each floored at its 0011 value, which runs against the model; HGB fits on 90% of its block by its inherited early-stopping protocol while trees and logistic use 100%; the model head selects one of eight while the baseline side selects four winners from four lists, so the winner's curse on the baseline side is larger, again against the model.
scope.selection_never_sees_the_evaluation_set: Two invocations. --stage select gathers only the holdout and the stage blocks; every gather is intersected with the evaluation index array and the count banked (must be 0); it never materialises an evaluation row and ends by writing artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048_selection.json. --stage confirm refuses without that file, embeds it verbatim, banks its sha256 (which the reader recomputes from the file on disk) and binds that hash into every confirmatory ledger entry; it fits the roles in the preregistered order with the model LAST, so no model evaluation number exists on disk until every baseline number is banked. Conditional on the selected recipes (a function of pool rows alone), each confirmatory fit uses only pool rows and the evaluation chunks are disjoint from every pool chunk by the grouped split (measured), so each role's single evaluation accuracy is an unbiased estimate of that fixed recipe's accuracy on unseen source chunks. No maximum over candidates is ever taken on the evaluation set; the only maxima on the evaluation set are over baseline heads and against their floors, which bias the subtrahend upward, against the model. Disclosed: this is the second preregistration scored on this sealed set - 0011 scored it 13 times (4 rungs, 7 baselines, null, transfer) and 0012 adds 8 to 10 - and the rosters were written with 0011's evaluation numbers (0.1741, 0.1266, 0.1447) known. The binomial standard error of a 0.17 accuracy on 130000 rows is about 0.0011 (larger under chunk clustering), so the 0.0025 frozen gap is of the order of two standard errors; cluster-bootstrap 95% intervals over the 5000 evaluation chunks are banked for every confirmatory accuracy as INFORMATIONAL fields, never clauses. The holdout shares gutenberg-pool bytes with the fit pool (CORRECTIONS.md 2026-08-31, defect 2), which can tilt which recipe is selected toward a memorising one but cannot touch the honesty of an evaluation score; the gutenberg-excluded evaluation clause is retained for that reason.
scope.inherited_conventions_stated_so_they_are: HGB candidates with val 'frag' fit on the first int(0.9 n) rows of their block and pass the rest as an explicit X_val/y_val (the 0003/0007/0011 rule) - a fragment-level split that shares chunks with its fitting rows (7435 / 14902 / 18614 chunks at the three block sizes, measured 2026-09-03 by the design review), which is why M8 exists. M8 (val 'group') validates on every row of 10% of the block's chunks drawn with seed 20260826; the block is refilled from the memmap in [fit rows, validation rows] order so both are contiguous views, then refilled canonically. Scaled candidates standardise the float64 block IN PLACE with the mean and standard deviation of their fitting rows (zero-variance columns get scale 1) and standardise scoring chunks on the fly; the block is refilled afterwards. Every refill is probe-checked (sha256 of every 7813th row against the block's first materialisation) and the result banked; a mismatch aborts the run. Trees, dummies and unscaled logistic fit on the whole block. Every fit runs at OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL_NUM_THREADS=3 and nice 10 (0011's train_environment) under sklearn 1.9.0 and numpy 2.4.6, banked per record; a different value in any record is VOID, because 0011's seconds are the extrapolation basis and unconverged lbfgs paths are thread-sensitive, so a thread change is pipeline drift, not a recipe result. The null control shuffles the first 20000 pool rows' labels with the split's rng continuation exactly as run_carve.py does (rng.shuffle after grouped_split's own draws), so the shuffled labels are 0011's.
scope.cost: EXTRAPOLATION throughout; every multiplier is an ASSUMPTION labelled as such. Banked anchors: (A1) the incumbent on this corpus and environment, 12.1 / 26.0 / 125.5 / 1036.0 s at 1000 / 10000 / 100000 / 500000 rows (carve_generalisation_2048.json cost.train_seconds_per_rung, 3 threads, nice 10); (A2) the depth-16 tree 395 s at 500000 rows (engineering_log_0011.json). Cost anchors taken 2026-09-03 on training rows only, no scoring, no evaluation row, filed in artifacts/pivot/engineering_log_0012.json as 'cost anchor, not a measurement': ten HGB iterations without early stopping at 63 leaves take 27.6 s at 10000 rows and 93.7 s at 100000 rows (machine otherwise idle); at 10000 rows 31 / 127 / 255 leaves take 15.0 / 50.7 / 88.6 s and max_features 0.5 takes 25.6 s (contended by one background process); trees at 100000 rows: depth 8 43.7 s, depth 16 80.8 s, unlimited 154.3 s, unlimited with min_samples_leaf 20 97.7 s; ten lbfgs iterations of the logistic at 100000 rows: 4.5 s raw, 4.4 s standardised; the incumbent's early stopping fired after 11 iterations at 10000 rows and 22 at 100000 (n_iter_ on training rows, no scoring). ASSUMED per-iteration HGB costs: about 8 s at 100000 rows (63 leaves), about 30 s at 399831 rows and about 40 s at 500000 rows (row scaling between linear and A1's exponent 1.31), times leaf multipliers 0.55 (31), 1.8 (127), 3.2 (255) and 0.9 (max_features 0.5) from the 10000-row anchors; logistic about 0.45 / 1.8 / 2.25 s per iteration at 100000 / 399831 / 500000 rows (linear in rows from the anchor); trees linear in rows from the 100000-row anchors. WORST CASE = every HGB and logistic candidate runs to its max_iter cap: stage A about 61600 s (17 h: model stage 1 about 20900 s, model stage 2 about 28800 s, logistic about 9400 s, trees about 2400 s), stage B about 25800 s (7 h: model confirmatory about 19200 s, incumbent 1036 s, logistic about 4300 s, trees about 1200 s); TYPICAL (early stopping at about a third of the caps, lbfgs converging early on standardised inputs) about 23800 s for stage A and 11500 s for stage B, about 10 h in total, plus memmap gathers of minutes each and container restarts (0011 needed four launches). The stage-A cap in caps.selection_fit_seconds is 72000 s, about 1.2 times the worst case, so it can stop only a run that has left its own extrapolation. Memory (arithmetic, labelled): stage A holds the stage-2 block 3.54 GB (399831 x 1108 x 8) plus the holdout 0.44 GB; a tree adds a 1.77 GB float32 transient, HGB a 0.44 GB binned copy, an in-place logistic about 0.1 GB. Stage B holds the pool 4.43 GB plus the evaluation block 0.58 GB; a tree adds 2.22 GB, HGB 0.55 GB. The only banked HGB peak is 0003's 11.69 GB at 800000 rows on the 4096 corpus (engineering_log.json), most of it a phantom npz copy since removed by npzmap.py. The container reports 16.86 GB total memory and no visible cgroup limit on 2026-09-03; 0011's 13.94 GB ceiling is its banked environment. ru_maxrss and a 30-second heartbeat RSS are banked per fit. Disk: checkpoints are kilobytes; confirmatory records with 130000-int8 vectors about 390 KB each; the scores file about 5 MB; nothing else is written.
scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: RECIPE_FAILS, with margin F possibly clearing (informational) and the expanded readings failing. (1) The frozen gap is 0.0025, the incumbent's rate, horizon and leaf count were set once on pilot data at 4096 and never revisited at 2048, M1 is in the roster so the search cannot do worse than it on the holdout, and a horizon or rate change plausibly buys a few thousandths - so the searched model is expected near 0.175 to 0.19 on the sealed set. (2) The search is symmetric and the baseline side has the more obvious headroom: the 0011 logistic was an unstandardised lbfgs capped at 400 iterations, and a standardised, converged logistic plausibly gains one to three points, moving the frozen bar toward 0.14 to 0.16 and eroding the very 0.0025 the model search is trying to recover, so margin F is roughly a coin flip. (3) The expanded bar 0.1447 needs +0.0206 more than the incumbent has, the deep_tree head continues the axis that banked 0.0887 -> 0.1259 -> 0.1447 from depth 3 to 8 to 16 and is likely to raise it, and VERDICT.md itself says +0.0294 against the deep tree 'is not a gap a recipe search should be expected to close'. (4) Per family in 0011, base64 0.103 / binary 0.0925 / mixed 0.1098 for the model against 0.1041 / 0.0918 / 0.1138 for the depth-16 tree: three eighths of the evaluation set carry no margin, and feature_ablation.json banks that the short-window degradation is uniform across feature subsets - the signature of a representation ceiling that no HGB knob moves. A RECIPE_CLEARS would be the surprising outcome, and this preregistration is written so that it cannot be manufactured: the roster is hashed into the reader, selection cannot see the evaluation set, the baselines get the same search and are floored at their 0011 values, one confirmatory score per role is all the evaluation set ever emits, and the bar is 0.05 on all three readings.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: The transfer arm (a fair transfer reading would need the 4096 recipe searched too; 0011's transfer verdict stands). Carve sizes other than 2048, so no boundary below 2048 is bracketed even on a pass. The rung ladder and the slope. Any change to the feature set or any learned byte representation (0009 and 0010 stand). Model families off the enumerated list: no MLP, ExtraTrees or RandomForest head - the pilot banks the MLP at 0.0913 against HGB 0.1290 at n=20000 (engineering_log.json), no artifact banks a fit time for either on any corpus, and sklearn 1.9.0's MLPClassifier.fit has no X_val so its early stopping copies the pool through train_test_split, the mechanism behind the 0003 OOMs - a banked reason, not a preference; an architecture search is a separate preregistration with its own memory plan and cost anchor. Libraries absent from the banked environment (lightgbm, xgboost, catboost, torch: verified absent 2026-09-03), random search, seed sweeps, ensembles, intra-fit checkpointing. Per-family verdicts: per-family accuracies are banked for every record and carry no clause. The gutenberg pool leak is bounded by the non-gutenberg clause, not fixed. A RECIPE_CLEARS does not revise 0003, 0006, 0007 or 0011, does not license quoting 4096 numbers at 2048 or 2048 numbers at 1024, and is quoted at 2048 only; a RECIPE_FAILS proves that none of these eight model recipes clears under this protocol, not that no recipe exists. Nothing here establishes a buyer, a customer, a user or a partner; establishes_a_buyer is emitted False unconditionally and no outcome could change it.

lower rate, longer horizon: the standard boosting trade; the cap of 300 bounds the worst-case cost
capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 500000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1259 -> 0.1447 from depth 8 to 16 at 2048

the low-variance end: small trees with heavy L2; at chance 0.038 and top-1 0.17 the task is signal-starved and a lower-variance learner can beat a higher-capacity one at the same data

scope_parameters_sealed.passes_if: preregistration == '0012-recipe-search-2048'; smoke is False; stage == 'confirm'; the corpus block equals the sealed constants (carve 2048 from cache metadata, chunk size 32768, offset 75000, measured chunk-id range 75000..99999, 25000 chunks, 650000 rows, 1108 features, cache_y_sha256 and cache_g_sha256 equal to the manifest's); n_classes == 26 and chance_accuracy == 0.038462; the banked roster and roster_sha256 equal the reader's ROSTER_SHA256; the banked protocol block equals the reader's PROTOCOL constant field by field. Any mismatch is VOID.

sealed_sets.passes_if: The banked partition equals the sealed constants field by field: the evaluation set (130000 rows, 5000 chunks, 113412 non-gutenberg rows, index and label hashes), the pool (500000 rows, 20000 chunks, index, label and sorted-set hashes), the holdout (rule 'chunk_id % 5 == 0', 100169 rows, 4002 chunks, index and chunk-set hashes), the fit pool (399831 rows, 15998 chunks, hashes), the stage blocks (100000 and 399831 rows, keep 2 and 1, chunk counts, index and sorted-set hashes); split_is_grouped_by_source is True; the null block's sorted-set hash is the sealed one. Otherwise VOID.

no_leakage.passes_if: Measured chunk overlaps holdout/eval, holdout/fit-pool and fit-pool/eval are 0 and eval rows in the holdout and the fit pool are 0; the selection file exists on disk, its sha256 equals the artifact's selection_sha256, the embedded copy equals it, it is this preregistration's non-smoke stage-select output with the sealed roster hash, its partition block equals the sealed constants, it gathered 0 evaluation rows (the counter and every gather entry), it finished before confirmation started, and every 'selection_bound' ledger entry carries its hash. Otherwise VOID.

search_completed_as_enumerated.passes_if: For every searched head: exactly two stages; stage-1 records cover the roster in order, each with seed 20260825, the sealed stage row count, index hash and sorted-set hash, a params hash equal to sha256(canonical candidate), status 'fit' or 'infeasible_memory', finite scores when 'fit', and the banked environment (threads 3, nice 10, sklearn 1.9.0, numpy 2.4.6); the banked ranking, advanced set and winner equal the reader's re-derivation (highest holdout top-1 among 'fit', ties at 4 decimals to the lower roster index; keep 2 then 1). Any baseline-side record that is not 'fit' is VOID. On the model side at most 2 'infeasible_memory' records, each with banked evidence, and never M1. Knob-free heads select their single candidate with no stages. Otherwise VOID.

confirmatory_complete_one_scoring_per_ro.passes_if: complete is True; every head's confirmatory record has status 'fit', finite top-1, non-gutenberg top-1 and eight per-family accuracies, the selected id (no substitution), a params hash on the roster, the sealed pool hashes, seed 20260825, 500000 rows, probe_ok on every refill, the banked environment, exactly one 'completed' ledger event, and a 130000-length per-example vector in the scores file; the incumbent refit and the 0011 logistic refit likewise (or, when M1 / L1 won, they are the head's own record); the model's confirmatory completion is the LAST confirmatory completion in the ledger. Otherwise VOID.

reproduces_0011_fixed_recipes.passes_if: abs(incumbent_refit_top1 - 0.1741) <= 0.005 and abs(logistic_l1_refit_top1 - 0.1266) <= 0.005: the fixed 0011 recipes refit on the 500000-row pool exactly as 0011 fitted them and scored once on the sealed set must reproduce 0011's banked values (0011's own transfer model reproduced corpus A's matched-rung accuracy under the same convention). Failure is VOID: the run is not measuring 0011's pipeline, so any changed margin would be drift in disguise. The drifts are banked as readings.

null_control.passes_if: shuffled_label_accuracy <= chance_accuracy + 0.02, where the control is the SELECTED model recipe fitted on the 20000-row null block (sorted-set hash sealed) with 0011's shuffled labels and scored once on the sealed set. Above tolerance is VOID: the pipeline leaks under the chosen recipe.

bar_arithmetic.passes_if: The reader recomputes bar_h = max(head h's confirmatory top-1, floor_h) for the six baseline heads with the floors in scope.roster.protocol.floors, best_frozen_for_bar as the maximum over the frozen heads, best_expanded_for_bar over all six, and best_expanded_non_gutenberg_for_bar likewise on the non-gutenberg scores with floors_non_gutenberg; the banked values must equal the recomputed ones and the model receives no floor. Any inequality is VOID. The floors mean the searched baselines can raise the bar and never lower it below where 0011 left it.

margin_frozen.passes_if: round(final_top1 - best_frozen_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, where final_top1 is the selected model recipe's single evaluation top-1 at 500000 rows (banked to 4 decimals). This is the 0.0025 gap the run exists to test; the searched logistic can widen it.

margin_expanded.passes_if: round(final_top1 - best_expanded_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, the maximum now including best_single_feat and the searched deep_tree head (floor 0.1447).

margin_expanded_gutenberg_excluded.passes_if: round(final_top1_non_gutenberg - best_expanded_non_gutenberg_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, both on the 113412 evaluation rows whose family is not gutenberg (floor 0.1511). A missing field is VOID, never a pass. A frozen-non-gutenberg clause is not added: its bar can never exceed the expanded-non-gutenberg bar, so it would be redundant.

margin_arithmetic.passes_if: Every margin clause compares round(a - b, 6) against 0.05 - 1e-9 on accuracies banked to 4 decimals, as in 0011: a margin printed as 0.0500 passes and 0.0499 fails; the binary-float representation of the difference decides nothing.

arms: SYMMETRIC SEARCH: four searched heads (model, logistic, depth3_tree, deep_tree) with eight enumerated recipes each and the 0011 recipe first; stage 1 fits all eight on the sealed 100000-row block and scores them on the chunk-rule holdout; the top 2 refit on the whole 399831-row fit pool; the stage-2 winner (ties to the lower index) is the head's recipe. The three knob-free heads skip selection.

CONFIRMATORY, ONE SCORING PER ROLE, MODEL LAST: the incumbent (M1) and the 0011 logistic (L1) refit on the pool as reproduction controls, then majority, stratified, best_single_feat, the depth3_tree winner, the deep_tree winner, the logistic winner, the null control with the selected model recipe, and the model winner last - each fitted once on 0011's 500000 rows and scored once on 0011's evaluation set.

THE BASELINES CAN ONLY RAISE THE BAR: each baseline head's contribution is max(its searched confirmatory score, its 0011 banked score); the model has no floor. This is the rival explanation 'the searched baseline happened to score below its 0011 recipe on the evaluation set' closed as arithmetic, not as a paragraph.
SELECTION CANNOT SEE THE EVALUATION SET: a separate invocation that banks a measured count of evaluation rows gathered (0) and whose output file is hashed into every confirmatory ledger entry.

VALIDITY FIRST: a wrong corpus, set, roster or protocol, a leaking selection, a baseline that dropped out, a role scored twice, a reproduction outside 0.005, a leaking null control or a bar that does not recompute is VOID and brackets nothing.
PER-FAMILY accuracies and cluster-bootstrap intervals are banked for every confirmatory record; they carry no clause.
stop_rules: Any margin clause failing is RECIPE_FAILS, published at the same size as a pass would have been; a run in which only margin_frozen passes is RECIPE_FAILS, with frozen_reading_clears banked as an informational field stamped 'not a verdict, not quotable as a pass'.

A validity or control failure is VOID: the clause is named, nothing is bracketed, nothing is counted in either direction; a VOID run may be resumed from its checkpoints under the identical invocation and is never re-parameterised; a changed roster, rung, rule or tolerance is a new preregistration with this one's VOID or NOT RUN on the record.

NOT RUN is reachable only before the first evaluation-touching checkpoint and only by mechanical rules (a failed launch precondition; three consecutive launches of a stage that produced no new checkpoint; stage-A fit seconds above caps.selection_fit_seconds); it is filed as artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048_not_run.json, the reader prints it and exits 2, and nothing is re-scoped to fewer candidates, a smaller rung or a lower bar.

Once stage confirm has written any checkpoint the artifact exists at the sealed path with complete false and reads VOID naming the missing roles until every role is banked; abandonment after that point is a published VOID, never a silent NOT RUN; every confirmatory fit runs to completion with no time cap; the model winner is fitted last.
No candidate is added, removed or re-parameterised after freeze: the roster hashes to a literal in the frozen reader and sits under the sealed scope; a record whose params hash is off-roster is VOID.

The sealed evaluation set is scored exactly once per confirmatory role; no runner-up substitution on either side; no re-selection in stage confirm; no time-based or seconds-based eligibility anywhere; ties break by roster index only; interruptions are counted, never turned into a status; infeasible_memory is stamped only on a caught MemoryError or a kill whose last heartbeat RSS was at or above 12.5 GB, with the evidence banked.
The 0.05 bar is not lowered, 0011's three readings are all required, and absence, NaN or inf read as VOID.

This cannot revise 0003, 0006, 0007 or 0011; 0011's CARVE_FAILS and (2048, 4096] stand for the frozen recipe whatever this returns; revises_0003_0006_0007_0011 and establishes_a_buyer are emitted False unconditionally; no customer, user, partner or buyer is claimed.

Cost is banked beside the result (fit seconds, ru_maxrss and heartbeat RSS per record, launches, interruptions, refills, the environment) and gates nothing in the reader; every cost figure in this preregistration is labelled EXTRAPOLATION with its basis.
The corpus, the evaluation set, the pool and the partition are one draw and are not redrawn; smoke runs write only to the scratchpad, are stamped smoke true, and read VOID.

If the run cannot complete under the container's memory (an infeasible_memory on the baseline side, or a third on the model side, or the incumbent), the result is VOID, filed as such, and nothing in the recipe is changed to make it fit.

thesis.what_would_make_it_fail_honestly: The baseline side having more headroom than the model side: a standardised, converged logistic gaining one to three points would raise the frozen bar past the 0.0025 the model search is chasing, and an unlimited-depth regularised tree would raise the expanded bar the model already trails by 0.0206. And the representation ceiling: feature_ablation.json banks a uniform degradation from 4096 to 1024 across every feature subset, which no fitting recipe moves, and three eighths of the evaluation set (base64, binary, mixed) carry no margin for any recipe in 0011.
thesis.what_a_pass_would_mean: That the incumbent's 2048 failure was a recipe artefact, not a window property, for this recipe space: the working range of the carved-DEFLATE result would extend to 2048 bytes under a searched recipe, quoted at 2048 only, with 0011's verdict for the frozen recipe standing beside it and 1024 unmeasured under a search.
thesis.what_neither_outcome_means: Neither outcome names a buyer. Neither revises 0011. A RECIPE_FAILS says that none of these eight model recipes clears under this protocol, not that no recipe exists; a RECIPE_CLEARS says nothing below 2048.

invocation: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=3 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=3 MKL_NUM_THREADS=3; nice -n 10 python3 tools/pivot/run_recipe_search.py --stage select; then nice -n 10 python3 tools/pivot/run_recipe_search.py --stage confirm; then python3 tools/readers/recipe2048_verdict.py. Every path at its default: --prereg-file prereg/0012-recipe-search-2048.json, --cache data/pivot/carve_c2048.npz, --workdir artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048_ckpt, --selection-out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048_selection.json, --out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048.json, --scores-out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_2048_scores.json. Relaunching the identical command after a container restart is the whole recovery procedure; checkpoints are committed and pushed as they land.
